fast-core-workflows.scope: Fast logic checks for backup, patch, unlock, flash, install, and Library behavior. The native composed runner does not run this command automatically.

directory-source-seed.scope: Create the three configured native directory sources in Chromium, grant persistent access, reload, restart, validate the seed headlessly, and publish it. The initial seed setup requires visible interaction.

directory-source-resume.scope: Open a published native HTTPS seed in a new Chromium process and assert all saved directory handles are granted and readable.

full-library.scope: Register/verify the configured ROM, BIOS, and backup sources; settle the real collection; verify supported systems and Game Boy Tetris; wait for cover, atlas, and decode work to drain. Run at least once per development session. Prepare a full-library profile separately before using this command.

locked-backup-patch.runner: python3 tools/device-test/run.py --browser-profile no-backups-check --gwemu-profile stock-locked-playwright --gwemu-preset stock-locked --suite locked-backup-patch --virtual-desktop
locked-backup-patch.scope: Assert locked Status, add an isolated run-local OFW backup directory, create and verify a pristine backup, patch and unlock stock firmware, press B to return to stock, and assert unlocked Status. The backup workflow requires a directory with no existing OFW backup source.

dualboot-install.runner: python3 tools/device-test/run.py --browser-profile directories-ci --gwemu-profile stock-unlocked-playwright --gwemu-preset stock-unlocked --suite dualboot-install
dualboot-install.scope: Use the configured OFW backup, patch stock firmware, flash the dual-boot loader, install Retro-Go in bank 2, then restore stock and verify Retro-Go is removed. Tetris library sync is a separate scenario.

library-sync.runner: python3 tools/device-test/run.py --browser-profile roms-only --gwemu-profile retro-go-gwprov --gwemu-preset retro-go --suite library-sync
library-sync.scope: Assert Retro-Go and unlocked state on Status, then install Tetris through the Library UI on independent copies of a gwprov-provisioned seed.

navigation-smoke.scope: Navigate primary tabs and dependent Overview panes without a device; confirm Advanced mode presents its device-wait state.

guided-setup-navigation.runner: python3 tools/device-test/run.py --browser-profile clean --browser-preset clean --gwemu-profile retro-go-gwprov --gwemu-preset retro-go --test firmware/guided-setup
guided-setup-navigation.scope: Connect to a prepared Retro-Go device, verify Dual Boot, Only Retro-Go, and Return to Stock plans, and confirm the UI walkthrough performs no device writes.

advanced-pane-navigation.runner: python3 tools/device-test/run.py --browser-profile clean --browser-preset clean --gwemu-profile stock-unlocked-playwright --gwemu-preset stock-unlocked --test firmware/advanced-panes
advanced-pane-navigation.scope: Connect to a prepared stock device, open every Advanced firmware pane, validate headings, and capture screenshots without starting write, dump, or erase operations.

advanced-firmware-operations.scope: Browser-level file browser, image write, dump, and erase coverage on prepared emulator profiles. Run when the feature changes or periodically; avoid redundant long write matrices.

browser-compatibility.scope: Exercise app navigation on Firefox or WebKit. The current named-profile CLI supports distribution Chromium only.

retro-go-ready.runner: python3 tools/device-test/run.py --browser-profile clean --browser-preset clean --gwemu-profile retro-go-gwprov --gwemu-preset retro-go --suite retro-go-ready
retro-go-ready.scope: Assert unlocked protection and Retro-Go connection on Status; capture browser and emulator output and confirm seeds remain unchanged.

media-state-resume.runner: python3 tools/device-test/run.py --browser-profile roms-bios --gwemu-profile retro-go-gwprov --device-state daily --suite retro-go-ready
media-state-resume.scope: Reuse local device media, retain deterministic filesystem/hash records and verify the seed remains unchanged.
